status: physics-informed soft-decoding sensitivity analysis; not used for model training, metadata embedding, active selection, or accuracy claims

rules.name: initial_state_not_1x1
rules.scientific_statement: The observed trajectory is expected to start at (1 x 1).
rules.implementation: A non-(1 x 1) first decoded state receives a soft log-score penalty.

rules.name: skip_bad_before_other_reconstruction
rules.scientific_statement: A trajectory beginning in (1 x 1) is expected to pass through Bad before a different reconstruction type.
rules.implementation: Before Bad has occurred, decoding any non-(1 x 1), non-Bad state receives a soft log-score penalty.

rules.name: leave_htr
rules.scientific_statement: HTR is expected to be the final reconstruction; another reconstruction should not follow HTR.
rules.implementation: A transition from HTR to any non-HTR state receives a soft log-score penalty.

safeguards: The decoder requires an externally produced, calibrated six-state probability table and will not silently rescale it.
No rule is hard: a sufficiently strong framewise model score can override any physics preference.
The output always retains the raw framewise argmax, all three decoded paths, and change flags.
This is a trajectory-level decoding prior, not a metadata feature and not a training loss.
